name: so-me-studio
description: Draft, publish, and schedule social posts with images, videos, thread chains, and automatic first comments on supported platforms.

interface.longDescription: Social media studio is a productivity tool for social media work. Plan, schedule, and publish a week of posts to all your connected So-me Studio accounts from one ChatGPT conversation, without switching between social apps. Create multi-post threads on X, Threads, Bluesky, and Mastodon, and add an automatic first comment on supported platforms. Choose images and videos from your media library, check platform compatibility before you upload, review your posting calendar, edit upcoming posts, and track publication status. For social media managers, creators, and small businesses that already use So-me Studio. Requires a So-me Studio account with API/MCP access and connected social accounts. Media, thread, and first-comment support depends on the destination platform. Reddit and Google Business Profile are not supported in this release. The plugin does not provide analytics, inbox replies, billing, or AI image and video generation.
defaultPrompt: Choose a library image for Facebook and Instagram tomorrow at 10 AM. Confirm my caption and timezone before scheduling.
Create a three-post X thread draft about our launch, with "Learn more on our website" as the first comment. Do not publish.
Check which supported connected accounts can publish this video, then help me choose where and when to post it.

positive.description: Publish an image from the media library to Bluesky now
positive.prompt: Find calendar__c00-month.webp in my Social media studio media library and publish it to my Bluesky account now with the caption "Plan a whole month of posts in one calendar." Then send me the link to the live post.
positive.tools_triggered: list_accounts, search_media, validate_post_media, get_media_file, create_post, get_post
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin finds calendar__c00-month.webp in the media library and checks it against the Bluesky image rules. ChatGPT asks the reviewer to allow the write action. After approval, it publishes one image post with the exact caption to hisomestudio.bsky.social, reports the status Published and gives a link to the live post. It publishes to no other account.

positive.description: Schedule one post on Mastodon and a LinkedIn page, then show next week's calendar
positive.prompt: Schedule this post on my Mastodon account and my LinkedIn page for next Monday at 9:00 AM UTC: "New on our blog: 5 ways to plan a week of social posts in 30 minutes." Then show me my posting calendar for next week.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT asks the reviewer to allow the scheduled post. The plugin creates two text posts with the same text, one for Mastodon @somestudio and one for the LinkedIn page so-me-0047, both scheduled for next Monday at 09:00 UTC. It then shows next week's calendar with both posts on Monday. Nothing is published now.

positive.description: Move, edit and unschedule upcoming posts (run after test case 2)
positive.prompt: In my posting calendar for next week, move the Mastodon post to Tuesday at 3:00 PM UTC and add #SocialMediaTips to the end of its text. Then take the LinkedIn post off the schedule.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin finds the two posts from test case 2 on next week's calendar. ChatGPT asks the reviewer to allow the update. The Mastodon post moves to next Tuesday at 15:00 UTC, its text ends with #SocialMediaTips, and it stays scheduled. The LinkedIn post is taken off the schedule and changes to Pending. It is not deleted and not published.

positive.description: Save an X thread with an automatic first comment as a draft
positive.prompt: Write a three-post X thread with practical tips for batching a week of social posts. Add "Plan your week at so-me.studio" as an automatic first comment, and save it as a draft in Social media studio. Do not publish or schedule it.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT writes the thread and saves one draft for the X account @hisomestudio: the head post as the text, two thread parts of 280 characters or less, and the first comment "Plan your week at so-me.studio". It shows the saved draft. No post is published or scheduled.

positive.description: Check a video against four platforms before an upload
positive.prompt: Before I upload it, check if my video spring-launch.mp4 can be posted as an Instagram Reel, a TikTok video, a Facebook Reel and a Bluesky video. It is an MP4, 1080x1920, 2 minutes long, 120 MB, H.264, 30 fps. Tell me what to change for each platform that fails.
positive.expected_behavior: A read-only check: nothing is uploaded or published. Instagram Reel and TikTok video pass the basic checks. Facebook Reel fails because 120 seconds is more than the 90-second limit; the fix is to trim the video to 90 seconds or less. Bluesky video fails because 120 MB (114.4 MiB) is more than the 100 MiB limit; the fix is to compress it to less than 100 MiB.

negative.description: Writing help only. The user asks for caption ideas and no action on an account, so ChatGPT writes the captions itself. The plugin calls no tool, and no draft or post is created.
negative.prompt: Give me three short Instagram caption ideas for our autumn coffee menu.

negative.description: Likes, comments and comment replies are out of scope: the plugin has no analytics, comment or inbox tools. The assistant can read the post list to find the post, but it does not invent like or comment counts, posts no replies and calls no write tool. It tells the user to check and reply on Instagram.
negative.prompt: How many likes and comments did my last Instagram post get? Reply "Thank you!" to each new comment.

negative.description: Reddit and Google Business Profile are not supported in this release. The assistant says so, calls no write tool (create_post, schedule_post or create_draft) and publishes nothing.
negative.prompt: Post our launch announcement to our subreddit and to our Google Business Profile: "Social media studio now works inside ChatGPT."

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products, show prices, or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.3.1 has a clearer description, support and terms links, and updated review materials. Drafting, publishing, scheduling, media checks and the social-posting skill work as in 1.3.0.
